title: National Legal Services Authority (NALSA) - National Legal Aid Helpline
description: 24x7 toll-free national helpline providing free legal assistance, advice, and appointed legal aid advocates to eligible citizens under the Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987.
eligibility_criteria: Women, children, members of SC/ST, victims of human trafficking, industrial workmen, persons in custody, and individuals with annual income below statutory limits (typically ₹3,00,000, varies by state).

title: National Cybercrime Helpline (Citizen Financial Cyber Fraud Reporting)
description: Immediate helpline operated by Ministry of Home Affairs and Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C). Calling within the 'golden hour' of online fraud enables immediate freezing of defrauded funds across banks.
eligibility_criteria: All citizens affected by online financial fraud, cyber-stalking, identity theft, or electronic harassment.

title: National Consumer Helpline (NCH / INGRAM)
description: Government of India consumer helpline for registering complaints against e-commerce companies, service providers, airlines, and sellers before approaching consumer courts.
eligibility_criteria: Open to all consumers who purchased goods or services for personal use.

title: National Emergency Women Helpline & NCW
description: National helpline for women facing domestic violence, online harassment, stalking, or imminent threats to physical safety.
eligibility_criteria: Available to all women across India in distress.

title: Delhi State Legal Services Authority (DSLSA)
description: Free legal aid clinics, legal representation, and mediation services across all district court complexes in NCT of Delhi.
eligibility_criteria: Residents of Delhi meeting statutory income thresholds (annual income under ₹3 Lakhs) or belonging to protected categories.

title: Karnataka State Legal Services Authority (KSLSA)
description: High Court legal services and district legal aid across all taluks in Karnataka for civil, criminal, and labour disputes.
eligibility_criteria: Income ceiling ₹3 Lakhs per annum for general category; free for all women, children, and SC/ST.

title: Maharashtra State Legal Services Authority (MSLSA)
description: Legal aid clinics and panel lawyers across Mumbai, Pune, Nagpur, and all districts of Maharashtra.
eligibility_criteria: Income ceiling ₹3 Lakhs per annum or protected category under Section 12 LSA Act.

title: Kerala State Legal Services Authority (KeLSA)
description: Extensive legal aid clinics in panchayats, taluks, and High Court Legal Services Committee at Ernakulam.
eligibility_criteria: Income ceiling ₹3 Lakhs per annum or protected category.

title: Tamil Nadu State Legal Services Authority (TNSLSA)
description: Provides free legal aid, legal awareness, and Lok Adalat dispute settlement across Tamil Nadu.
eligibility_criteria: Statutory eligible persons and annual income below ₹3 Lakhs.

title: Uttar Pradesh State Legal Services Authority (UPSLSA)
description: District Legal Services Authorities (DLSA) in all 75 districts of Uttar Pradesh and High Court Legal Services Committee at Allahabad and Lucknow.
eligibility_criteria: Income ceiling ₹2 Lakhs per annum for general category; free for women, children, and custody inmates.

title: West Bengal State Legal Services Authority (WBSLSA)
description: Statewide free legal aid network across Kolkata and all district court complexes.
eligibility_criteria: Statutory criteria under Legal Services Authorities Act.

title: Bar Council of India & State Bar Councils Directory
description: Apex regulatory statutory body for the legal profession in India. Users can verify advocate enrollment status through respective State Bar Councils.
eligibility_criteria: Public directory and complaint authority against professional misconduct.
